risk_note: RV2 by path (db, platform maintenance). BR-ID-30 item 7 (D10-451): union_raw_payloads is kept 180 days by dropping whole monthly partitions. New SECURITY DEFINER function app.drop_expired_union_raw_payload_partitions(p_now, p_days), EXECUTE for couli_maint only, drops only children named union_raw_payloads_pYYYYMM whose catalogue upper bound is at or before the fixed +08:00 calendar-day cutoff; the partition key is fetched_at and the range is half-open, so every row in such a partition is expired and no rows are read. DEFAULT is never dropped; the 180 floor is enforced inside the function as a second gate. Maintenance section L runs inside the existing 04:00 gate under retention.purge.enabled, with days from configuration and fallback to the 08 value; one failure does not stop the other cleanup and logs carry names and counts only. DROPPABLE_TABLES and the event_log rule are unchanged because a frozen contract test pins them, so this is a separate function rather than an entry in that list. db/schema.sql regenerated from a live database.
